question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP

decoded.body: a React application shell, 3,225 bytes, described in its own meta tag as "API as a Product - Developer Portal"; its content is rendered by script and, per the entry's 2026-09-13 browser read, is a sign-in form; the API reference is behind it. This is the record's subject because it is the only FourKites surface that answers a machine with anything but a not-found
decoded.api-root: GET https://api.fourkites.com/ with no Authorization header answers 404 application/json {"message":"no Route matched with those values"}: a gateway's default not-found, with no www-authenticate header and no pointer to documentation
decoded.guessed-path: GET https://api.fourkites.com/api/v1/tracking/shipments (a path guessed from the product's vocabulary, not from any published reference) answers the same 404 and the same 48-byte body: a wrong path and a right path without credentials are indistinguishable from outside, because no path is published
decoded.challenge: none on any of the three responses
decoded.mcp: none: the entry lists no MCP server and mcp.fourkites.ai was NXDOMAIN on 2026-09-13, so no MCP request was made

finding: FourKites publishes no MCP server and no API reference an unauthenticated reader can open, so this probe stops at the front door. With no credentials, the developer portal answers 200 with a script-rendered application shell whose visible content, read in a browser for the entry on 2026-09-13, is a sign-in form. GET api.fourkites.com/ answers 404 with a gateway's default JSON body and no www-authenticate header, and a path guessed from the product's vocabulary answers the identical 404, so from outside there is no way to tell a wrong path from a gated one. No response names a credential type, a realm or a document. Same 404 and same portal as the entry's note. The empty cells here are the finding: an agent without an account cannot learn from any public surface what this API expects, and this record does not guess.

reproducibility.command: for u in https://api.fourkites.com/ https://api.fourkites.com/api/v1/tracking/shipments https://developer.fourkites.com/; do curl -sS -i -m 25 "$u" | head -c 4000; echo; done
